requirements.statement: to_runner and run_and_exit parse the argument list, build one model instance and call the runner with it, returning its integer exit code; missing or invalid values never call the runner and return non-zero.
Field constraints and @validator checks still reject values before the runner; runner exceptions go through exception_handler; prologue runs before and epilogue after the runner.
Fields become --<name> flags; Field(cli=...) customizes short and long flags; description and default appear in help; List and Set fields accept several values; Enum fields accept member values.

bool fields with a default get one negating flag, required and Optional bool fields get an enable/disable pair or a custom pair, Optional[bool] = None stays None, and Config.CLI_BOOL_PREFIX replaces the prefixes.

CLI_JSON_ENABLE adds --json-config (renamed by CLI_JSON_KEY); file values satisfy required fields and are overridden by explicit options; CLI_JSON_CONFIG_ENV_VAR supplies the default path; a missing file fails without calling the runner.
--help and --version print and return 0 without the runner; pydantic_class_to_parser returns the parser; SubParser maps dispatch to the selected model and runner.

The same behavior holds when only Pydantic moves from 1.10.15 to 2.6.4 with the rest of the lock unchanged; user models keep class Config with CLI_* attributes and Field(cli=...); only Python modules under pydantic_cli/ change.
